verdict: key consistent: 90 signs = 90 letters, 25 groups = 25 words, every shape one letter; the red gloss agrees letter for letter except one skeleton-level variant (ح for خ) and one unread red letter
notes: Seven cipher rows on 1v, segmenter lines 3-9 of image 0084_0007 (the record gives 3-8: line 9, a short row of 5 signs under row 8, is the end of the verse 'جاريا'). Rows 15+14+14+13+14+15+5 = 90 signs; 24 dividers (three dots over a stem; on rows 5 and 7 the three dots are run together into one blob over the stem, no red letter over them); rows 6 and 8 end with a divider. A red letter stands over every sign and gives the same letter as this alignment. Record errors (cipher, red gloss and the 2r l.2 copy agree): 'فمالي' -> 'فما بال' (S13 with red ب; 1v l.11 also reads 'فما بال'), 'لمتم' -> 'لمت' (3 signs, 3 red letters), 'استغفر' -> 'اتمنعني' (7 signs, red ا ت م ن ع ن ي; 2r l.2 reads 'اتمنعني'), 'من ذا ان غدا جاريا' -> 'من ان اساعد جاريا' (groups 2, 2, 5, 5; red م ن / ا ن / ا س ا ع د / ? ا ر ي ا). The cipher writes 'العين' (not 1v l.11's 'للعين'). Second hemistich as enciphered: 'فقلت لهم قد لمت طرفي فقال لي اتمنعني من ان اساعد جاريا'. Over S9, S5 and S10 in row 8 (اتمنعني) an extra red loop (ط/ه-like) stands before the expected red letter; unexplained. Red over the first sign of row 9 is a ع/ج head with a dot at the right (ج or غ): recorded as '?'. Red over S15 (row 5, الخد) is a dotless ح-shape: skeleton agrees with خ. S10 is written with two dots in four places and one dot (or one long dot) in two; taken as one sign. ق is written by a bare stroke (S2) and ا by the ligature عا (S6).
